overloads.semanticRole: The WP USE PAGE SETUP command modifies the current printer page settings based on the 4D Write Pro document attributes for page size and orientation.

constraints: Should be called just before WP PRINT to synchronize the current printer page settings with the 4D Write Pro document's page size and orientation.
Other print settings are defined separately via 4D PRINT SETTINGS.
Print settings changed by this command apply for the whole 4D session.
